payout_quote: Once qualifications are met, you and your friend will both receive $10 deposits into your accounts.
steps: Be a FORUM Credit Union member
Invite a friend to open a new FORUM Checking, Savings, or Loan product by filling out the referral form
Friend opens the new product with a $50 minimum deposit and mentions the referral during account/loan opening
Both you and your friend receive $10 deposits into your accounts in 4-6 weeks
catches: Only $10 per referral — one of the smallest verified payouts in the lane
Friend must mention the referral during account/loan opening; referral card must reach a FORUM employee at opening
Health and secondary checking accounts excluded; new loans only (no refinances of current FORUM loans)
Accounts must be in good standing
Cannot be combined with any other offer
biggest_catch: The payout is only $10 per referral — and it still takes 4-6 weeks and paperwork at account opening.
eligibility: FORUM CU members; friends open a new checking, savings, or loan product with a $50 minimum deposit
